whitening: exact float64 covariance eigendecomposition fitted separately in each training segment
joint_fit: 250 Cayley gradient steps; start selected by training objective from identity, SFA, real-Schur bases; no label or development selection
schur: Also evaluate natural 1x1/2x2 diagonal groups; Schur form is generally upper-block-triangular, not block diagonal
lag_svd_dual: Two orthogonal bases from SVD of unsymmetrized lag1 covariance: current uses U, future uses V; explicitly not a shared coordinate factorization or full VAMP whitening implementation
labels: Explicit keyed schema. Cylinder activations continuous; scores categorical with integer/range assertions; ball direction sin/cos; constant Pong magnitude excluded.
input_target_convention: row vectors: x[t+h]=x[t]@A+intercept; only same-split temporal pairs
acceptance_gates: synthetic math selftests pass before feature extraction
dataset schema and temporal index audits pass
primary_endpoints: mean position R2 with4-coordinate supervised diagnostic
within-encoder block predictor MSE relative to dense and persistence
limitations: 3 disjoint segments are not 3 independent environments
no causal interpretation from covariance or Schur blocks
model comparisons not matched in pretraining/capacity
